name: ai-slop
description: Catches AI slop in any prose and adds a scientific layer for empirical software engineering papers (voice and tense, statistical reporting per APA/IEEE/ACM, citations) and a LaTeX layer (BibTeX verification, reference checks against CrossRef/DBLP, citation macros, grounding comments). Both layers load automatically for .tex source, and --scientific opts a non-LaTeX manuscript into the scientific layer. Optional --ste and --economist layers apply Simplified Technical English rules and core Economist style advice to any prose. Combines these with the AI trope catalog by Ossama Chaib at tropes.fyi. Repository mode reviews the text of a whole code repository, including comments, user-facing strings, and UI text. The glossary modes build or maintain a GLOSSARY.md for a document or a repository and check its terminology against it.
